## What is covered

**Yes** means the query runs on a sift index or table: `Custom Scan (SiftScan)` or `SiftCount` for the BM25 `sift` index, `Custom Scan (SiftAgg)`
for aggregates over a `sift_col` index or a `sift_table`. **Partly** is Yes under the condition in brackets. **No** means the query keeps
the normal PostgreSQL plan: the result is the same, correct, only not accelerated, never wrong and never an error; a **No** is a query shape that is
not proven yet, not a limit of what you can write. **Error** is the few cases where sift raises an error instead (the setting that avoids it is in
brackets). To check a query, run `EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF)` on it: a `Custom Scan (SiftAgg)` (or `SiftScan`, `SiftCount`) node is sift, anything else is
the normal plan, and `SET sift.enable_agg = off` gives the plan PostgreSQL has without sift to compare results. Every row below has a sample query that is run on a test cluster by
`scripts/coverage.sh --check`; the complete table (every aggregate, type, key, predicate, join and limit, with the proof of each row) is in
[docs/COVERAGE.md](docs/COVERAGE.md).

**Search** (BM25 `sift` index)

| Query / feature | Covered by sift? | Index or engine | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| All terms: body @@> 'clean wifi' (words are ANDed) | Yes | BM25 | `SELECT id FROM docs WHERE body @@> 'breakfast friendly'` |
| Phrase: "friendly staff" | Yes | BM25 | `SELECT id FROM docs WHERE body @@> '"friendly staff"'` |
| Prefix (cle*), wildcard (w?fi), regex (/thank.*/), fuzzy (clen~1) | Yes | BM25 | `SELECT id FROM docs WHERE body @@> 'brea* OR n?isy OR /no.*y/ OR frendly~1'` |
| Ranked top-k: ORDER BY sift.score(ctid) DESC LIMIT k | Yes | BM25 | `SELECT id, sift.score(ctid) FROM docs WHERE body @@> 'pool OR spa' ORDER BY sift.score(ctid) DESC LIMIT 10` |
| count(*) of a match | Yes | BM25 | `SELECT count(*) FROM docs WHERE body @@> 'friendly'` |
| Match with other filters: score ranking plus a range or equality filter | Yes | BM25 | `SELECT id FROM docs WHERE body @@> 'friendly' AND published >= '2026-02-01' ORDER BY sift.score(ctid) DESC LIMIT 10` |
| Keyword facets: sift.facets(index, facet_index, query, limit) | Partly (keyword analyzer, text keys, a table without row-level security) | BM25 | `SELECT * FROM sift.facets('docs_body', 'docs_category', 'friendly OR pool', 10)` |
| Aggregate over the rows of a match: GROUP BY with @@> in the WHERE | Partly (the match runs on the BM25 index (SiftScan), the aggregate on the normal plan) | BM25 | `SELECT source, count(*) FROM orders WHERE memo @@> 'clean' GROUP BY source` |
| sift.score() in WHERE | Error (0A000; filter on the score from a subquery) | BM25 | `SELECT ... WHERE body @@> 'a' AND sift.score(ctid) > 1` |

**Analytics** (`sift_col` index on a heap table or a `sift_table`: aggregates, `GROUP BY`)

| Query / feature | Covered by sift? | Index or engine | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| count(*) | Yes | sift_col, sift_table | `SELECT status, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status` |
| count(DISTINCT col) | Yes | sift_col | `SELECT status, count(DISTINCT store_id) FROM orders GROUP BY 1` |
| sum, avg, min, max of numeric(p<=18, s) | Yes | sift_col | `SELECT source, sum(total), avg(total) FROM orders GROUP BY 1` |
| stddev, variance family | Yes | sift_col | `SELECT source, stddev(total), var_pop(store_id) FROM orders GROUP BY 1` |
| percentile_cont, percentile_disc with a constant fraction | Yes | sift_col | `SELECT source, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total::float8) FROM orders GROUP BY 1` |
| FILTER (WHERE ...) on any aggregate | Yes | sift_col | `SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'paid'), sum(total) FILTER (WHERE total > 100) FROM orders` |
| numeric(p > 18), unconstrained numeric, negative scale | No (the index refuses the column, so no query reads it from the index) | sift_col | `SELECT grp, sum(n38) FROM t GROUP BY grp` |
| GROUP BY an expression of one column: lower(), CASE, date_trunc of a date, x % 7, extract() | Yes | sift_col | `SELECT date_trunc('month', placed_at::timestamp)::date, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1` |
| GROUP BY date_trunc, extract of a timestamp or timestamptz, or CASE over numeric | Yes | sift_col | `SELECT date_trunc('month', ts), count(*) FROM t GROUP BY 1` |
| GROUPING SETS, ROLLUP, CUBE, GROUPING() | Yes | sift_col | `SELECT store_id, status, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY CUBE (store_id, status)` |
| LIKE, ILIKE, prefix, regex (~), any boolean function of one text or integer column | Yes | sift_col | `SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE source LIKE 'market%'` |
| INNER JOIN to a small table on equality (lookup join, up to 4 tables, up to 3 key columns) | Yes | sift_col | `SELECT s.kind, count(*), sum(o.total) FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id GROUP BY s.kind` |
| EXISTS (...) and IN (SELECT ...) (semi join) | Yes | sift_col | `SELECT count(*) FROM orders o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stores s WHERE s.id = o.store_id AND s.kind = 'outlet')` |
| NOT IN (SELECT ...) | No (a hashed SubPlan with the NULL rule of NOT IN, no anti join) | sift_col | `SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE store_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM stores WHERE kind = 'outlet')` |
| Per-order aggregates with the outer aggregate in the same scan: UNION ALL arms (up to 4), HAVING or WHERE on the inner aggregates, gates, ROLLUP / GROUPING SETS, count(DISTINCT id) | Yes (in v3, pending merge) | sift_col | `SELECT category, kind, avg(avg_price), count(DISTINCT order_id) FROM (... GROUP BY order_id, ...) x GROUP BY ROLLUP (category, kind)` |
| Parallel scan of the aggregate (count, sum, avg, min, max, count(DISTINCT), percentiles, keys of any kind, lookup joins, grouping sets) | Yes | sift_col | `SELECT store_id, count(*), sum(total) FROM orders GROUP BY store_id` |
| Rows inserted after the index was built, not yet vacuumed (pages not all-visible) | Yes | sift_col, sift_table | `SELECT grp, count(*), sum(v) FROM t GROUP BY grp` |

**Tables** (`sift_table` access method)

| Query / feature | Covered by sift? | Index or engine | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| sift_table: numeric(p > 18) and unconstrained numeric, uuid, interval, bytea, money, time, arrays | No (stored exactly but not read as values by the aggregate scan) | sift_table | `SELECT u, count(*) FROM t GROUP BY u` |
| Aggregates over a sift_table: count, sum, avg, min, max, distinct, filters, grouping | Yes | sift_table | `SELECT grp, count(*), sum(i4) FROM t WHERE i4 > 100 GROUP BY grp` |
| Backward scan: a SCROLL cursor fetching backward, FETCH PRIOR / LAST | Yes | sift_table | `DECLARE c SCROLL CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM t; FETCH LAST FROM c; FETCH PRIOR FROM c` |
| More than 127 columns | Error (54000 at CREATE TABLE; at most 127 columns) | sift_table | `CREATE TABLE t (c1 int, ..., c128 int) USING sift_table` |

<!-- coverage:end -->
